document.title: Finite-time blow-up for the Navier–Stokes equations
document.credit: Adapted from the paper by Alpöge and Buckmaster. Prepared by Will Cook with AI assistance.
document.credit_note: Explanatory reading edition prepared by Will Cook

notes: The introduction explains what cutting off a reference flow achieves and why a further correction is needed on each domain.
The proof distinguishes the linear forced solve from the coupled update that makes the net auxiliary force vanish.
The exposition spells out the critical L³ concentration estimate for the localized whole-space solution in the unrotated case.
